scientific_integrity: The arithmetic node splitting field is proved by an exact squared-node calculation and a normal-local square-class specialization argument. Prime-density claims use Chebotarev; finitely many sample primes are consistency checks only.
scientific_limitations: Generic five-node locus and the single rational tuple (2,3,4,5,6). No classification of nongeneric members or exhaustive bad-reduction primes. This is arithmetic Galois action, not geometric monodromy. The original geometric singularity classification is credited to Moriya and Kudo.
title: Biquadratic Galois action on the generic five-node Howe sextic, with an explicit prime-density specialization
